sloka: किं तु मां विद्धि ब्रह्मर्षे शासनात्पितुरागताम् ।कैकसी नाम नाम्नाहं शेषं त्वं ज्ञातुमर्हसि ।। ७.९.१९ ॥
transliteration: kiṁ tu māṁ viddhi brahmarṣe śāsanātpiturāgatām ।kaikasī nāma nāmnāhaṁ śeṣaṁ tvaṁ jñātumarhasi ।। 7.9.19 ॥

translations.english: "But know me, O Brahmarshi, as one who has come by the command of my father; I am named Kaikasi by name, and you are capable of knowing the rest."
